item.title: [VIA] Project Embers Core Team Recruitment
item.description: What’s up Hwa Chong❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥 We are Project Embers🔥and we are looking out for the new Core Team of 2026/2027‼️ So why is Project Embers all about?🤔 We are an SL project aimed at providing entertainment and engaging elderly in fun activities! From origami🦜 to karaoke🎤 our sessions are fun, enriching experiences that warm the cockles of our hearts, bringing out the EMBERS❤️‍🔥 of warmth and joy as we help the elderly🧓👵 So what are you waiting for? Do sign up if you are interested to be a part of the Project Embers Core Team in the link below👇 https://forms.gle/2fqhDZZwVPjePJCV6 Finally, do follow us @project_embers.25 for more info about our project! If you have any further queries, do contact Isaiah @211611m@student.hci.edu.sg. Thank you and looking toward to see u at our SL! 🤩🤩 Yours sincerely, Project Embers Core Team 25’26
